Date Posted: 09th July 2026

ABN: 45677999263

Position: Storeperson

Basis of Employment: Full-time (38 hours per week)

Salary: $75,000 to $85,000 + 12% Superannuation

Location of workplace: 20 Lachlan Street, Condobolin NSW 2877

Rudraksha Energy Pty Ltd (ABN: 45 677 999 263 | ACN: 677 999 263) is an Australian-owned, family-operated fuel retail and convenience business located at 20 Lachlan Street, Condobolin, NSW 2877. The company is committed to providing quality fuel products, convenience retail services, and excellent customer service to the local community and travellers passing through the region.  Service station offers a range of essential products and services, including fuel, convenience store items, snacks and beverages, grocery essentials, automotive accessories, and other everyday necessities. We are dedicated to maintaining a clean, safe, and welcoming environment while delivering reliable service and competitive pricing.

As our business continues to grow, we are seeking a reliable and motivated Storeperson to join our team on a full-time basis. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys hands-on work in a fast-paced retail and warehouse environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in receiving and organising stock, maintaining inventory, replenishing shelves, ensuring the storeroom remains well organised, and supporting the day-to-day operations of the business to ensure customers receive outstanding service.

Key Responsibilities:

•	Unload deliveries safely and efficiently 

•	Inspect incoming stock for accuracy, damage, and quality 

•	Record and report any discrepancies or damages 

•	Label, categorize, and store items in designated locations 

•	Ensure stock is rotated according to FIFO (First In, First Out) principles 

•	Monitor stock levels and report shortages or overstock 

•	Conduct regular stocktakes and reconciliations 

•	Maintain accurate inventory records using inventory management systems 

•	Operate pallet jacks, trolleys, and other warehouse equipment safely 

•	Perform routine maintenance checks on equipment and report any issues 

•	Maintain a clean and safe working environment 

•	Handle hazardous materials safely and follow relevant protocols 

•	Perform ad hoc tasks as required by the supervisor or manager 

•	Continuously look for ways to improve workflow and efficiency

Requirements:

•	Previous experience in a similar role (minimum 1 year) 

•	Good physical fitness and ability to lift items 

•	Strong attention to detail and organisational skills 

•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team 

If you meet these requirements and are ready to take on this critical role, please reply directly to this email recruit@gvrc.com.au with your updated resume and cover letter. We look forward to reviewing your application!

 This role would suit engineers with experience in Defence, aerospace, rail, maritime, automotive or other highly regulated environments who enjoy working at the intersection of requirements, testing, integration and system performance. 
   
  Key Responsibilities  
 
 Support the development, management and traceability of system requirements. 
 Conduct systems engineering activities across the full engineering lifecycle. 
 Develop Verification & Validation strategies, plans and procedures. 
 Define and execute verification activities including analysis, inspection, demonstration and test. 
 Support system integration, test readiness reviews and acceptance activities. 
 Work closely with software, hardware, mechanical and project engineering teams to ensure requirements are met. 
 Identify, investigate and resolve technical issues throughout the development lifecycle. 
 Contribute to requirements management, risk assessments and engineering documentation. 
 Support customer reviews, technical presentations and engineering governance activities. 
 
   What you'll need to succeed       
 
 Degree qualified in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related discipline. 
 Experience working within Defence or other complex engineering environments. 
 Strong understanding of systems engineering principles and processes. 
 Experience developing or managing requirements using tools such as DOORS, DOORS Next, Jama or similar. 
 Experience supporting Verification & Validation, integration or testing activities. 
 Ability to interpret technical specifications and translate them into testable requirements. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement, communication and problem-solving skills. 
 Australian Citizenship

 Defence industry experience. 
 Experience across the full systems engineering lifecycle. 
 Exposure to Systems Engineering standards and V-Model methodologies. 
 Experience preparing test plans, verification procedures and validation reports. 
 Knowledge of system integration and acceptance testing.

   What you'll get in return
